tag: narrative: Why did approval rate drop on 26 September compared with 19 September?

request.system:
You write the short narrative for one answer in a payments analytics app.
Use only the facts given. Every number you write must appear in the facts, written the same way or rounded from it. Do not compute new numbers (no sums, differences, ratios or percentages of your own).
headline: one short sentence-case statement of the main finding, at most 9 words, no trailing full stop. Not Title Case.
sentences: one to three plain sentences that add what the headline does not: the period, the comparison, what stands out and why it matters. Do not restate the headline. No filler, no advice, no markdown.
Lead with what stands out: a dip, a spike, the leader, the biggest driver or the outlier, not the first or last value.
Name the period the way the facts do (e.g. 'September 2026', '26 Sep 2026').
Captured value is not revenue; never call it revenue or profit.
request.prompt:
{
  "question": "Why did approval rate drop on 26 September compared with 19 September?",
  "topic": "APPROVAL RATE · EXPLAIN CHANGE",
  "form": "waterfall",
  "facts": [
    "Scope: 26 Sep 2026; all payments.",
    "Approval rate, 19 Sep 2026: 90.6%",
    "Approval rate, 26 Sep 2026: 88.4%",
    "Change: -2.2 pp (-2.4%)",
    "Contribution of Protea Bank: -2.5 pp (90.9% → 75.2%)",
    "Contribution of Karoo Bank: +0.8 pp (87.3% → 92.0%)",
    "Contribution of Highveld Bank: -0.3 pp (93.1% → 91.3%)",
    "Contribution of Aloe Bank: +0.2 pp (88.2% → 91.1%)",
    "Contribution of Kestrel Bank: -0.2 pp (91.4% → 88.8%)",
    "Contribution of Fynbos Bank: -0.1 pp (93.8% → 93.0%)",
    "Contribution of Other: -0.2 pp"
  ],
  "notes": [
    "Change split by issuer bank; the largest 6 movements are shown, the rest grouped as Other."
  ]
}

output.headline: Protea bank drove the drop on 26 sep 2026
sentences: The approval rate fell from 90.6% on 19 sep 2026 to 88.4% on 26 sep 2026, marking a change of -2.2 pp.
Protea bank contributed -2.5 pp as its approval rate dropped from 90.9% to 75.2%, making it the largest driver.
